disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure or refusal to comply with rules and requirements of the Division of Professional Regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Certificates issued under this chapter may, after a hearing before and upon the recommendation of the board of examiners of electricians, be suspended or revoked by the director of labor and training, upon failure or refusal of the licensee to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation or for other sufficient cause.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other sufficient cause as determined by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: suspended or revoked by the director of labor and training, upon failure or refusal of the licensee to comply with the rules and requirements of the division of professional regulation or for other sufficient cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to perform work in accordance with city or town rules and requirements, or failure to correct defective work after notice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to do that work in that manner, or his or her failure or refusal to correct the work with reasonable promptness after notice by local inspection or enforcement authorities... shall be grounds for suspension or revocation of the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to perform work in accordance with the National Electrical Code or rules specified by the division or electric utility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any licensee to do the work in that manner shall be considered grounds for suspension or revocation of the license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any misstatement as to experience or other qualifications in a license application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person applying for a license and making any misstatement as to his or her experience or other qualifications, or any person, firm, or corporation subscribing to, or vouching for, any misstatement, shall be subject to the penalties prescribed in § 5-6-32.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing, impeding, or obstructing entry and free access to premises by authorized division investigators
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If any owner, occupant, or other person refuses, impedes, inhibits, interferes with, restricts, or otherwise obstructs entry and free access to any part of the building, structure, or premises by an authorized investigating official of the division of professional regulation... the chief administrator of the division may: (1) Revoke or suspend any license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering upon or engaging in electrical business without having complied with licensing provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person, firm, association, corporation, or employee of any person, firm, association, or corporation, and any representative, member, or officer of any firm, association, or corporation individually entering upon or engaging in the previously defined business and work, without having complied with the provisions of this chapter, shall be assessed penalties pursuant to § 5-6-32.
